claims.claim_vi: The source contrasts traditional configuration management (maintaining desired state of provisioned items, initial manual setup, step-by-step commands) with IaC (automated provisioning, often declarative, tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Chef and Puppet, source-controlled files).
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Puppet and Chef describe desired state of resources, and Ansible tasks are typically written to be idempotent; the line between configuration management tools and IaC tools is blurry.
claims.verified_by: Kiến thức chung của người biên soạn, chưa đối chiếu lại với trang này trong phiên viết (không mở được trang từ môi trường).

claims.claim_vi: Toy drift model: two declared web servers (port 80, TLS on) against a reality where one port was changed to 8080 and a third server exists; the plan holds 2 changes (update port, delete the extra server); after applying, a new comparison finds 0 changes.
claims.verified_by: Run by the author on 2026-10-19 with a small Python program that compares two dictionaries.

design_notes_vi: Hai khung ghi chú đối xứng và một khung bốn bước cho việc phát hiện lệch.
source_deviations: The source files Chef and Puppet under IaC; the lesson notes that many references file them under configuration management and that the boundary is blurry.
The lesson adds a drift-detection experiment, which the source does not contain.
